questions.q: What distinguishes a requirement from a wish?
options: A measurable criterion and a verification
Having an identifier and an author
questions.explain: “Accelerates to 15 m/s in 3 s” is a requirement; “fast” is not.

questions.q: What should a drone's one-sheet architecture contain?
options: A price list and links to shops
The PCB routing of the flight controller
questions.explain: Without it, it's unclear what has been proven.

questions.q: What do you do after any configuration change?
options: The tests affected by the change and a changelog entry
questions.explain: The regression rule and the changelog.
Date, what, why, how it was verified.

questions.q: What do the conclusions of accident investigations have in common?
questions.explain: A lack of method, not an isolated breakdown.

questions.q: Which tests are done without props?
options: Hover and flight time at full load
questions.explain: Ground checks are done without props; flight metrics only in the air.

questions.q: What do the arrows on the power diagram show?
questions.explain: The power diagram shows what powers what and how much current flows through each line.
